input.user_message:
Read the Session 1 recap at `Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 1 - Recap 3-27-24.md` and extract all meaningful scene events as structured event records.

For each distinct beat, fight, conversation, discovery, travel segment, or confrontation in the recap, produce one event_record with:
- event_class (one of: conversation, travel, combat, discovery, transfer, ritual, betrayal, disaster, investigation, social_conflict)
- participants (use the known character slugs below — only include slugs that actually appear in that event)
- location (brief description of where it happens, or null if unspecified)
- outcomes (list of concrete results or facts established by the event)
- time_scope (use "scene" for specific session events)
- certainty (use "observed" for events directly described in the recap)
- event_name (short descriptive name for the event)
- evidence_id (set to the recap path: "Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 1 - Recap 3-27-24.md")

Known character slugs: karsemine, stafl, caelynn, ephanna, bonogo, baergrom, grishna, glowkindle

Extract 5–12 events. Do not merge multiple distinct beats into a single event. Do not invent events not described in the recap.

expected_events.event_name: Party arrives outside Stonebridge as merchant guards
outcomes: Mish-mash of travelers arrives outside Stonebridge after traveling together as merchant guards
Party named: Karsemine the Tiefling Ranger, Stafl the Human Bard, Caelynn the Half Elf Sorcerer, Ephanna the Kenku Warlock, Bonogo the Bugbear Rogue, Baergrom the Dwarf Fighter

expected_events.event_name: Party drinks at River's Edge Pub; Grishna shares directions to Wizard's Tower Brewing Co
outcomes: Party drinks at the River's Edge Pub run by Grishna the Half-orc to wash away the road
Grishna shares that Glowkindle had been through the pub and his Wizard's Tower Brewing Co is up river, west at the big rock, walk till you see it
Job board at Stonebridge advertises Glowkindle's request for mercenaries to clean up rats

expected_events.event_name: Bonogo buys a firkin of ale from Grishna for two gold
outcomes: Bonogo, having very little awareness of the cost of things and greatly enjoying the beer, buys a firkin of ale for two gold
Bonogo enjoys the hike to the brewery carrying the firkin

expected_events.event_name: Party hikes upriver past the enormous statue-foot boulder to Wizard's Tower Brewing Company
expected_events.location: trail along the river west of Stonebridge
outcomes: Party follows clear trail along the river to an enormous boulder that resolves into the foot of an enormous statue
Another few hours walk along the trail leads the group to the Wizard's Tower Brewing Company
The brewery's tap room is bustling, lit by magical crystals, with a troupe of gnomes busily brewing

expected_events.event_name: Party meets Glowkindle and accepts the rat-clearing contract
expected_events.location: Wizard's Tower Brewing Company tap room
outcomes: Glowkindle explains that giant rats assaulted his excavation crew after they broke through a wall expanding the fermentation cellar
Glowkindle offers a healthy prize of 25 gold pieces each for clearing out the rats
The team agrees to take the contract

expected_events.event_name: Combat with giant rats in the expanded fermentation cellar
expected_events.location: fermentation cellar of Wizard's Tower Brewing Company
outcomes: Clearing the giant rats was significantly harder than expected
Multiple party members went down during the fight
A mysterious cat owl was tossed into the room to help
Combat produced a lot of blood from rats and teammates
Many, many health potions were consumed before victory
The combat brings the team together as a fine first fight

expected_events.event_name: Party explores the brewery interior — beautifully tiled hallway, trapped mosaic, broken alchemical tools
expected_events.location: deeper rooms beyond the fermentation cellar
outcomes: The team finds a beautifully tiled hallway
A trapped mosaic on the ground is discovered
A room full of broken alchemical tools is found

expected_events.event_name: Karsemine spots a flaming magma-infused spider monstrosity in the shatter mages tower
expected_events.location: deeper room beyond fermentation cellar (interior of the shatter mages tower)
outcomes: While searching the alchemical room, Karsemine looks up and makes eye contact with another resident
The resident is some kind of flaming magma infused spider monstrosity
The location is identified as the shatter mages tower
Cliffhanger: the encounter is unresolved at session end
